festival-season.title: Festival Season
festival-season.description: Summer music festivals, gigs and crowds, mostly shot on 35mm film.
festival-season.rule: Music festivals, concerts, gigs, stages, crowds, festival campsites, wristbands, live music venues.

street-life.title: Street Life
street-life.description: Everyday people and moments on city streets, markets and town squares.
street-life.rule: Candid people in streets, markets, shops, squares, parades, pedestrians. Not empty buildings.

after-dark.title: After Dark
after-dark.description: Cities and streets at night: light trails, neon and lamplight.
after-dark.rule: Night scenes, light trails, neon, illuminated buildings, dusk cityscapes.

coast-and-cliffs.title: Coast & Cliffs
coast-and-cliffs.description: Beaches, sea cliffs, grottoes and the shoreline.
coast-and-cliffs.rule: Beaches, cliffs, sea, waves, sand, piers, driftwood, grottoes, people at the beach.

harbours-and-boats.title: Harbours & Boats
harbours-and-boats.description: Fishing boats, marinas, harbours and riverside moorings.
harbours-and-boats.rule: Boats are the subject: harbours, marinas, moorings, boatyards, rowing boats, ferries.

tuscany.title: Tuscany on Film
tuscany.description: Hill towns, cypress roads and summer days in Tuscany.
tuscany.rule: Clearly Tuscany or Italy: Siena, Florence, hill towns, cypress landscapes, Italian streets and signs.

algarve.title: Algarve
algarve.description: Whitewashed towns, coves and marinas on Portugal's southern coast.
algarve.rule: Clearly the Algarve or Portugal: Alvor, Lagos, Portuguese tiles, flags, Algarve coast.

alpine.title: Alpine
alpine.description: Snow, mountain huts and high peaks.
alpine.rule: Snow, mountains, ski areas, alpine lodges and chalets, winter landscapes.

architecture.title: Facades & Architecture
architecture.description: Buildings, windows, doors, towers and the shapes cities are made of.
architecture.rule: Buildings or architectural detail are the subject: facades, windows, doors, churches, brutalist and modern buildings, walkways.

countryside.title: Countryside & Landscapes
countryside.description: Fields, rivers, hills and open country.
countryside.rule: Rural landscapes, fields, rivers, lakes, forests, hills (not alpine snow, not coast).

gardens-and-flowers.title: Gardens & Flowers
gardens-and-flowers.description: Blooms, borders, garden paths and green spaces.
gardens-and-flowers.rule: Flowers, gardens, plants, parks, garden paths, botanical close-ups.

portraits.title: Portraits & People
portraits.description: Faces and people as the subject, posed or candid.
portraits.rule: A person or people are the clear subject at close or medium range (portraits, couples, friends). Street crowds go to Street Life.

signs-and-lettering.title: Signs & Lettering
signs-and-lettering.description: Shop signs, neon, painted lettering and typography in the wild.
signs-and-lettering.rule: Signage, lettering, neon signs, painted words and typography are the main interest.

wheels.title: On Wheels
wheels.description: Classic cars, camper vans, bikes and scooters.
wheels.rule: Vehicles are the subject: classic cars, Fiat 500s, VW vans, bicycles, Vespas, buses, trains.

home-and-still-life.title: Home & Still Life
home-and-still-life.description: Interiors, objects and seasonal still life.
home-and-still-life.rule: Interiors, rooms, homeware, objects, ceramics, seasonal decorations, still life arrangements, people decorating homes.

food-and-cafe.title: Café Culture
food-and-cafe.description: Coffee, terraces, restaurants and food on the table.
food-and-cafe.rule: Food, drink, cafes, restaurant terraces, coffee, market produce as subject.

abstract.title: Abstract & Texture
abstract.description: Colour, texture, light leaks and double exposures.
abstract.rule: Abstracts, textures, fabric folds, bokeh, light leaks, double exposures, patterns with no clear scene.

animals.title: Dogs & Other Animals
animals.description: Dogs, birds, livestock and the odd cat.
animals.rule: An animal is the clear subject.

black-and-white.title: Black & White Film
black-and-white.description: Monochrome frames, mostly on Ilford and Kodak black-and-white stock.
black-and-white.rule: Any monochrome / black-and-white photo (in addition to its subject theme).
